root_idea.summary: A root oriented toward the gentle removal or displacement of one thing from another, especially through rubbing or continuous movement.
root_idea.development: The evidence connects rubbing across a surface with the westward movement of the sun and with derivative meanings involving rubbed substances, prepared foods, wear, habituation, and removal.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quran-attested verbal noun with an independently supported lexical meaning.

senses.definition: The sun’s decline from the meridian, its westward movement after noon.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction لِدُلُوكِ الشَّمْسِ, this reading understands the expression as beginning at the sun’s noon decline and can include the noon and afternoon prayer times.

senses.definition: The sun’s decline toward sunset, including its sinking or setting.
senses.usage_conditions: In لِدُلُوكِ الشَّمْسِ, this is the sunset or approach-to-sunset interpretation. The same celestial usage is also recorded of the stars by analogy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rub, rub and press, knead, or wipe by rubbing with the hand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of such actions as rubbing a garment, grain, the eyes, or a sandal, and kneading dough.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of time or fortune, to discipline, test, and make a person experienced or firm in judgment; of journeys, to inure or exhaust a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of the effect of repeated hardship or experience.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of land, to have its produce or herbage eaten or consumed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative passive use describing land as though it had been rubbed away.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a reported usage, the sun became high.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a separately reported classical interpretation and is not used to define the Quranic occurrence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To feed, nourish, or rear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II use distinct from the ordinary rubbing sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To defer payment to a creditor or put someone off by repeated promises; by extension, to engage in a contest of patience or to press persistently for a due.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially associated with debts, dowries, or other rights and payments.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rub or press one’s own body, especially in washing or in a hot bath; to rub oneself with a cleansing or perfuming substance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reflexive Form V usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The time of the sun’s decline or setting, hence afternoon or evening.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A time noun used in expressions identifying the period of the sun’s westward movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Looseness or laxness in a camel’s knees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily condition of the camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An unidentified small animal, creeping creature, or insect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The identification of the creature is explicitly uncertain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A substance or implement used for rubbing the body in washing, such as a cleanser, depilatory, or foot-rasp.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes materials used in the hot bath and the tool used to rub the feet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dust carried away by the wind, as though rubbed from the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative descriptive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A food made from butter and dates, including dates softened and mashed by rubbing or pressing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Comparable to a preparation like tharīd.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person made firm or sound in judgment through experience and diligent practice in managing affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative description of an experienced, capable person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular plant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical identification is botanical and independent of the food meaning of دَلِيكٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The red, sweet fruit of the wild rose or mountain rose.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The fruit is described as becoming red and sweet when ripe.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The milk drawn from an udder before the next quantity has collected.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dairy term referring to the final milk between successive milkings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A preparation of dates, clarified butter, and dried curd kneaded or pressed together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A food identified with حَيْس.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who rubs and presses the body in a hot bath.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An occupational noun for a bath masseur.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An affair or case of great magnitude, gravity, or importance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Its plural is دَوَالِيكُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A manner of walking marked by urging or pressing forward and by spreading the legs apart.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic description of gait or pace.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who repeatedly delays or defers payment to a creditor by making successive promises.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The transmitted entry gives مُدْلِكٌ, while the lexical form is reported as probably مِدْلَكٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rubbed smooth or polished.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial use describing the result of rubbing and pressing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, having flattened or non-projecting bony prominences, especially at the brow or hip.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical description applied to a horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel, inured or fatigued by journeys.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial use describing habituation or exhaustion through travel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel, having laxness or looseness in the knees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized bodily description, distinct from the travel-worn sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land whose produce or herbage has been eaten or consumed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative passive description of land as rubbed away.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who delays, defers, or puts someone off by repeated promises.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A participial noun associated with withholding payment or fulfillment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who does not hold himself above a low or ignoble action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct characterization of conduct, not merely a synonym for delaying payment.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Pointer-only continuation to the verb entry.

cautions: The single Quran occurrence in 17:78 is lexically interpreted either as the sun’s meridianal decline or as its decline toward sunset and setting; the supplied lexical evidence supports both readings.
The uncertain botanical and zoological identifications are retained as reported rather than presented as secure modern identifications.
